messages.content: Rode 40 minutes and got chest pain and palpitations on the last climb. Should I still do the VO2 session tomorrow?
Chest pain and palpitations on the climb are a stop sign, not a training question. See a physician before you ride again, and I will not plan any training until you are cleared.
